answer: The strongest single control I know for this is scout membership hash with organisation attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One voyage of signal, one wharf of cost, one beacon of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
